Check arguments against type signature

Source: R/linter-check.R
check_arguments.Rd

Check arguments against type signature

Usage

check_arguments(
  fn_name,
  args,
  type_info,
  call_node,
  source_expression,
  mode = "lenient"
)

Arguments

fn_name

Function name

args

List of call_argument S7 objects

type_info

Type information for function

call_node

XML node of the call

source_expression

Source expression

mode

Type checking mode ("lenient", "exported", "strict")

Value

List of Lint objects
